title: The Raven's Ledger of Kambria
summary: Break the stranglehold of usurious debt-collectors and mutinous deserter companies occupying the karst vaults and scarp forts of Dwynnen.

npcs.name: Syndic Bertrand Vane
npcs.greet: Mind your purse on the Kambria causeway, friend. Between Daggerfall's bailiffs and Wayrest's factors, even the stones owe interest.
talk: A rogue chapter-master of the Knights of the Raven has bought up the war-debts of thirty upland farms and hired discharged pike-companies to evict the tenants.
They hold the forged bond-books inside Oakwold Keep and the karst sinkholes of Telaata. Speak with Cantor Eloise in Balmarsh—her parish was seized yesterday.

npcs.name: Cantor Eloise of Dibella
npcs.greet: Three ravens sat on our gable at dawn, and by noon the debt-pikemen had nailed our chapel doors shut.
talk: Old soldiers who fought at Shinji's Scarp are being forced to choose between starving on the moor or serving Bailiff-Knight Corvus as mercenaries.
Corporal Gaspard at Wyngate still commands veterans who refuse to turn their pikes on their own neighbours.

npcs.name: Corporal Gaspard
npcs.greet: I served twelve winters on the Bjoulsae marches, and I'll not spend my thirteenth burning tenant cottages for a usurer's seal.
talk: Paymaster Grignon keeps the silver press and the forged mortgage rolls inside Wynham Cavern, guarded by deserters.
If we seize those rolls and march on Oakwold Keep and Telaata, every honest veteran in Dwynnen will turn against Corvus.

npcs.name: Dame Laure of the Raven
npcs.greet: Thank the Eight! I came from Dwynnen to audit Corvus's preceptory, and his mercenaries locked me outside the barbican.
talk: Corvus has retreated into the karst vaults of Telaata beneath the ridge, where he intends to sell the forfeited land-deeds to Wayrest speculators.
Help me breach Telaata and reclaim the Raven's honour!

story_dw_balmarsh_eviction: Cantor Eloise of Dibella: Look at the seal on this writ—a black raven clutching a debtor's chain, stamped over a scraped-out Kambria deed.
Syndic Bertrand Vane: They're altering the land-rolls from the old war so neither Daggerfall nor Wayrest will intervene.
Cantor Eloise of Dibella: Go to Shinji's Scarp and Wyngate; rally Corporal Gaspard before another family is driven onto the moor.
story_dw_wynham_mint: Paymaster Grignon: Every pikeman in these hills owes me for his boots and salt! Who are you to audit my books?
Corporal Gaspard: The men bled at Shinji's Scarp while you clipped their pay-tallies, Grignon!
Paymaster Grignon: Guards! Add their bones to the lime-pit!
story_dw_telaata_vault: Bailiff-Marshal Corvus: Dwynnen is a beggar's ditch between two greedy crowns! Under my ledger, at least the pikes are fed!
Dame Laure of the Raven: The Order of the Raven was sworn to guard the karst passes, Corvus, not auction our people into bondage!
Bailiff-Marshal Corvus: Then let steel settle the balance!

quests.title: Three Ravens on the Gable
quests.summary: Investigate the seized parish in Balmarsh with Syndic Bertrand and Cantor Eloise.
intro: Deserter pike-bands bearing the seal of the Knights of the Raven have begun seizing upland farms around Kambria and Balmarsh.
Travel from Kambria to Balmarsh and examine the eviction writs with Cantor Eloise.
complete: The writs in Balmarsh were forged on scraped war-parchment. Cantor Eloise urged you to meet Corporal Gaspard via Shinji's Scarp.

journal.start: Syndic Bertrand in Kambria asked me to travel to Balmarsh and inspect the forged debt-writs with Cantor Eloise.
journal.done: We proved the eviction writs are falsified and learned Corporal Gaspard at Wyngate is gathering loyal veterans.

Speak with Cantor Eloise in Balmarsh

quests.title: Ghosts of Shinji's Scarp
quests.summary: Scout the mercenary muster-ground at Shinji's Scarp and rally Corporal Gaspard in Wyngate.
intro: Discharged soldiers gather around the old siege works of Shinji's Scarp, where Bailiff-Marshal Corvus recruits his enforcers.
Reconnoitre Shinji's Scarp, then travel to Wyngate to speak with Corporal Gaspard.
complete: Corporal Gaspard agreed to muster the loyal veterans once the forged debt-press in Wynham Cavern is destroyed.

journal.start: I must scout Shinji's Scarp and meet Corporal Gaspard in Wyngate.
journal.done: Corporal Gaspard pinpointed Paymaster Grignon's counterfeit press inside Wynham Cavern.

objectives.text: Scout the deserter campfires at Shinji's Scarp

quests.title: The Coin-Shear's Cavern
quests.summary: Enter Wynham Cavern, defeat Paymaster Grignon, and seize the forged mortgage ledgers.
intro: Paymaster Grignon uses the dry limestone chambers of Wynham Cavern to stamp counterfeit debt-tallies and pay off deserter captains.
Fight your way into Wynham Cavern and take the ledgers from Grignon.
complete: With Paymaster Grignon defeated and the true ledgers recovered, Corporal Gaspard's veterans marched to join Dame Laure at Oakwold Keep.

journal.start: I must enter Wynham Cavern and defeat Paymaster Grignon to recover the true debt-rolls.
journal.done: I slew Paymaster Grignon in Wynham Cavern and learned Bailiff-Marshal Corvus has fortified Telaata.

objectives.text: Confront Paymaster Grignon at the seal-press

stages.objective: Confront Paymaster Grignon at the seal-press

quests.title: The Karst Vault of Telaata
quests.summary: Join Dame Laure at Oakwold Keep, storm the karst vault of Telaata, and defeat Bailiff-Marshal Corvus.
intro: Bailiff-Marshal Corvus has retreated into the subterranean vaults of Telaata with the charter-chest of Dwynnen.
Meet Dame Laure outside Oakwold Keep, descend into Telaata, and end Corvus's extortion ring.
complete: Bailiff-Marshal Corvus has fallen, the forged bonds have been burned in Kambria's square, and Dame Laure has restored the Order of the Raven.

journal.start: I must speak with Dame Laure at Oakwold Keep and defeat Bailiff-Marshal Corvus in Telaata.
journal.done: I defeated Bailiff-Marshal Corvus in Telaata and returned the freed deeds to Syndic Bertrand in Kambria.
